info.title: SAIHub REST API
info.description: JSON REST API for logical pins 0-7, PWM, UART, SPI, I2C, power rails (3v3/5v), the onboard buzzer, edge tracing, resource locks, on-device Lua 5.4 scripts, system info / firmware update, and cloud management. All time fields are microseconds. JSON keys are camelCase. Error bodies are {"reason":"..."}. While a firmware update is in progress, non-system routes return 503.

tags.name: script
tags.description: Sandboxed Lua 5.4. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8. require/dofile/loadfile/load/collectgarbage are nil. No io, os, package, debug, or coroutine. Tools are globals with MCP argument keys. sleep(us) delays in microseconds. print() is captured. First return value is result. Errors raise {reason="..."}; catch with pcall. Timeout, maxCalls, and out-of-memory abort the run.

tags.name: cloud
tags.description: Named cloud grants minted by pairing. LAN has no bearer; cloud-proxied calls require a live grantSecret.

tags.name: system
tags.description: Device identity, running firmware metadata, and over-the-air update check/upgrade. System routes remain available while an update runs; other routes return 503.

Pin tools are plural and take pins arrays; create_lock resources use type pin+pins, type power+rails, type uart+ids, type spi+ids, or type i2c+ids. See tools/list.

post.description:
Execute a sandboxed Lua 5.4 script that can call the same pin/power/UART/SPI/lock tools as MCP (not run_script). Optional maxCalls and timeout (microseconds) must not exceed firmware ceilings. Default lock for nested tool calls: X-Lock-Id. One script at a time.

Lua 5.4. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8. require, dofile, loadfile, load, and collectgarbage are nil. No io, os, package, debug, or coroutine.

Each tool is a global that takes one argument table with the same keys as MCP (always pass pins even for one pin). JSON arrays become 1-based Lua tables. sleep(us) delays in microseconds and counts toward timeout, not maxCalls. print() is captured as output. The first return value is result (JSON).

Errors raise a table {reason="..."}. Catch with pcall and read err.reason. Uncaught errors fail the request with that reason; print output is discarded.

Catchable with pcall:
- Tool failure: system sentence (no "The script reported" prefix), e.g. pin/lock/mode errors
- error("msg"): "The script reported an error: msg. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."
- error() or error(""): "The script called error with no message. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Not catchable (abort the whole run even if pcall returns):
- timeout: "Script exceeded timeout."
- maxCalls: "Script exceeded maxCalls."
- out of memory: "Script ran out of memory."
- syntax or uncaught Lua runtime: "The script failed: <message>. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Example:
configure_pins{pins={0}, mode="digitalOutput", pullUp=false, pullDown=false}
set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
sleep(5000)
local r = get_pin_levels{pins={0}}
print("level", r.levels[1])
return r

Error handling:
local ok, err = pcall(function()
  set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
end)
if not ok then
  return {ok=false, reason=err.reason}
end

400.description: invalid JSON, out-of-range params, or Lua source failed to parse

422.description: Uncaught error() or tool failure, timeout, maxCalls exceeded, or script heap exhausted

get.description: Returns the current enable flag and pins. pins.nreset is null when reset is unwired. enable false means the TCP service is stopped.

post.description: enable true claims pins.swclk, pins.swdio, and pins.nreset when set, then starts the TCP service. enable false stops it and releases those pins.

mode native (default when omitted) requires baudRate, dataBits, parity, stopBits, and encoding. mode rfc2217 accepts only enable, pins, and mode. When enable is true, at least one of pins.rx or pins.tx is required.

get.description: prompt explains how to connect. 503 when this UART is not enabled in rfc2217 mode.

200.description: SPI inventory. clockHz is present only when role is master.

post.description: One role at a time. CS is active-low. clk and cs are required integers when enable is true, and may be null when enable is false. mosi and miso may be null. Duplicate pins are rejected. A slave body must not include clockHz. A master body must include clockHz.

Blocks until the clocks finish. data is an even-length hex string of 0-255 bytes. Empty data clocks nothing and returns data "". Non-empty data requires pins.mosi. When pins.miso is unset the response data is "". When both data lines are set, response data has the same length as the request.

200.description: Bytes shifted in, or an empty string when MISO is unset

get.description: Requires an enabled slave with pins.miso set. Drains the event buffer. An empty buffer returns events []. When the buffer is full, the oldest events are discarded.

post.description: Does not wait for a master. Requires an enabled slave with pins.mosi set. mapping replaces the previous map. An empty array clears it. Match exact entries first, then the longest prefix. An empty prefix matches every receive. The stored map is used for the transaction after the one already in flight.

200.description: I2C inventory. clockHz and sclWaitUs are present only when role is master. address is present only when role is slave. pullUp and addressBits are always present.

post.description: One role at a time. sda and scl are required integers when enable is true, and may be null when enable is false. Duplicate pins are rejected. pullUp enables weak internal pull-ups; external pull-ups are still recommended. addressBits is 7 or 10. A slave body must include address and must not include clockHz or sclWaitUs. A master body must include clockHz and sclWaitUs (0 uses the driver default) and must not include address.

Blocks until the transfer finishes. address range follows the bus addressBits (0-127 for 7, 0-1023 for 10). write is an even-length hex string of 0-255 bytes. readLen is 0-255. timeoutMs is optional (default 1000, range 1-60000). Empty write with readLen 0 probes the address. Non-empty write with readLen > 0 uses a repeated start. Response data length equals readLen.

200.description: Bytes read, or an empty string when readLen is 0

get.description: Requires an enabled slave. Drains the event buffer. An empty buffer returns events []. When the buffer is full, the oldest events are discarded.

post.description: Does not wait for a master. Requires an enabled slave. mapping replaces the previous map. An empty array clears it. Match exact entries first, then the longest prefix. An empty prefix matches every receive. The stored map is used for the read after the receive already in flight.

get.description: Whether this device is connected and authenticated to the cloud relay, the public landing page URL, and a reason when not connected.

connected.description: True when the cloud relay WebSocket is up and authenticated

landingPageUrl.description: Public cloud landing page for this device. Empty when cloud relay is disabled.

reason.description: Empty when connected; otherwise why the device is not connected

get.description: Returns every grantSecret stored on the device. Cloud-proxied calls require a live grantSecret in the WebSocket request envelope.

XLockId.name: X-Lock-Id
XLockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource+method (pin, power rail, UART, or SPI). Missing or unknown yields 412; a different live holder or peripheral reservation yields 423.

TimeUs.description: Unix epoch or duration in microseconds

openDrain.description: Allowed for digitalOutput, digitalInputOutput, and pwmOutput

level.description: digitalOutput: last written latch. Otherwise sampled pad input.

frequency.description: Hz. Very low frequencies may be rejected.

reason.description: Present after overcurrent, overtemperature, or reverse-voltage turns the output off. Example: "Overcurrent, overtemperature, or reverse-voltage detected at 2026-11-06T14:30:15Z. Output disabled." Omitted after the rail is enabled again.
Human-readable fix sentence, except invalid_json and internal

result.description: First Lua 5.4 return value as JSON, or null. JSON arrays in tool results are 1-based Lua tables.

url.description: WebSocket URL for the TCP byte stream.

DapStatus.description: Local responses include prompt, port, and ip. Cloud responses include prompt and url.

UartPins.description: DTR and RTS are active-low outputs. Assigned control lines start released (pin high).

UartNativeConfigBody.description: mode native, or omitted. Framing fields are required.

UartRfc2217ConfigBody.description: mode rfc2217. Only enable, pins, and mode are accepted.

UartConfigBody.description: mode native (default when omitted) requires framing fields. mode rfc2217 accepts only enable, pins, and mode.

url.description: WebSocket URL for the TCP byte stream.

Rfc2217Status.description: Local responses include prompt, port, and ip. Cloud responses include prompt and url.

active.description: True asserts the active-low line (pin low). False releases it (pin high).
Stored assertion state. True means asserted (pin low). False means released (pin high).

data.description: UTF-8 text when encoding is utf8; even-length hex when encoding is byte.
UTF-8 text when encoding is utf8; even-length hex when encoding is byte.

SpiBytes.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

SpiClockEdge.description: 0 or 1. cpol is the clock idle level. cpha is which edge samples.

I2cBytes.description: Even-length hexadecimal bytes. An empty string is zero bytes.

pullUp.description: Weak internal pull-ups on sda and scl. External pull-ups are still recommended.

sclWaitUs.description: Master wait for slave SCL stretch, in microseconds. 0 uses the driver default.

pullUp.description: Weak internal pull-ups on sda and scl. External pull-ups are still recommended.

address.description: Slave address. Max 127 when addressBits is 7, max 1023 when addressBits is 10.
Device address. Max 127 when bus addressBits is 7, max 1023 when addressBits is 10.

timeoutMs.description: Transfer wait timeout in milliseconds. Default 1000 when omitted.

Unauthorized.description: Cloud request grantSecret missing or not stored on the device

NotFound.description: Unknown URL, pin in path out of 0-7, UART id missing from GET /uart/, SPI id missing from GET /spi/, I2C id missing from GET /i2c/, or lock id missing on PUT

Conflict.description: A request overlaps an existing lock, peripheral hold, or active trace; resource configuration conflicts with a held pin; or UART I/O while mode is rfc2217

BuzzerBusy.description: Another buzzer sequence is already playing

Unprocessable.description: Pin mode cannot perform the operation, PWM resources exhausted, UART not enabled / missing direction pin, SPI not enabled / wrong role / missing data pin, or I2C not enabled / wrong role / NACK / transfer timeout

Locked.description: Resource+method held by a different live lock, or reserved by a peripheral such as UART, SPI, or I2C
